beats.texto: Don't panic! It's telling you something.
Dry air from the heater steals water.
Or the soil dried out completely.
Water deeply and move it away from heat.
Never sure when? There's an app that tells you.
Comment APP and I'll send you the link!

legenda: Brown tips on an areca palm are a message, not a death sentence. Dry air and thirsty soil are the usual suspects.
